name: itinera
description: Client-side explorer for Google Maps Timeline exports (single self-contained HTML).

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('src').filter(f => f.endsWith('.js'))) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'src/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.test: npm run check && python3 build.py test && python3 tests/smoke.py
scripts.shots: python3 build.py test && python3 tests/shots.py light && python3 tests/shots.py dark
